howToApply: Visit the UPSC Online Recruitment Application portal at https://upsconline.nic.in/ora/
Complete Account Creation and Universal Registration to obtain a Universal Registration Number (URN).
Fill up the Common Application Form (CAF) including uploading photograph and capturing live photograph.
Fill up the post/vacancy specific module for the desired post.
Upload all required documents/certificates in support of claims (Date of Birth, Caste, Disability, Educational Qualifications, Experience, etc.) in PDF format.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 25/- online (if applicable) via Visa/Master/Rupay Credit/Debit Card/UPI or Internet Banking. Fee is waived for Female/SC/ST/PwBD candidates.
Submit the application before 1800 Hrs on 14-08-2026.
Take a printout of the finally submitted Online Recruitment Application for future reference.
Candidates are not required to send printouts by post; bring them at the time of interview if called.
